Package com.hottes.caleb.ultimateticktacktoe.gameindependant

Class GameState

java.lang.Object
com.hottes.caleb.ultimateticktacktoe.gameindependant.GameState
Direct Known Subclasses:
BoardState, SubBoardState
public abstract class GameState extends Object
Represents a state of a Monte Carlo Tree Searchable game and provides methods to be implemented for any specific game. This class works for 2 player tune based non random determinisic games that are played on 2 dimenisional boards and contain pieces for each player. For any given state the player whose turn it is to play is represented by postiive values, and the opponent is negative. If a square is empty then it contains a zero.

    • getEvaluation

      public abstract double getEvaluation()
      Evaulates the state and retuens a number between 1 and -1 this could be simple logic or For chess it could be the output of a neural network. 1 means that the state is good for player 1 and -1 means that the state is bad for player 1

    • preformAction

      public void preformAction(GameAction action) throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
      This method tries to set the value in the state array at the speficifed location to the marker value If the action is not on the board, ie less than 0 or greater than m board size then a normal arrayindex out of bounds is thrown This method does NOT check if the action is legal according the the games rules this method is itended to do whatever is nessacary to prepare the board for the next move. that could mean flipping whose turn it is, changing custom properties of the board etc.
      Parameters:
      action - the action to be preformed
      Throws:
      ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - if the action is not on the board,

      public abstract GameState simulateAction(GameAction action, boolean invertBoard)
